title: His Mower Makes Grass LONGER 🌿
description:
Our neighbor mows his lawn at three in the morning, with his eyes shut, and somehow the grass gets longer. On our street, you don't look while it's running.

My dad has lived next door to him for six years and never said a word. Then Mr. Odell knew his coffee order before he ordered it. So Dad set an alarm.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment COFFEE if you know your neighbor's order.
